entities.summary: Mark Hart is an American musician and multi-instrumentalist. He was a member of Supertramp and Crowded House, and has also worked as a touring and session musician for Ringo Starr and others. Hart has composed film scores and is a record producer. Mark Hart was a composers & musicians from Fort Scott (b. 1953-07-02, Fort Scott). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
